Exact finite witnesses and explicit bound are justified by finite pigeonhole; no finite checking is misrepresented as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Franel numbers are a classical sequence with known prime-three nondivisibility. Their complete set of values at every 3-power modulus and resulting p-adic Haar measure form a natural invariant. Establishing maximal allowed image, infinitely many explicit sparse witnesses, and a computable existential bound resolves a motivated question beyond routine parity or a small finite table.
